notes: Read from the revised 2026 guide, percentage method (pages 51-52), on 2026-10-18: 4.99% rate, standard deduction $30,000 married filing jointly (spouse not working) and $15,000 single, head of household or married filing separate, $5,000 per dependent allowance.
The guide says employers had to keep withholding 5.19% until the rate change took effect and may start withholding 4.99% from 2026-05-11. Paychecks before the switch may have used 5.19%.
The calculator's 'married' status uses the married-filing-jointly deduction. Two-earner couples use $15,000 on Form G-4 and will see lower pay than estimated.
Official worked example on page 51: $2,000 semi-monthly, married, one dependent withholds $27.03.
